test_policy.notes: ORU says it is 'currently test score optional'. The freshman checklist lists 2.6 GPA, 20 ACT, 1030 SAT, 66 CLT as admission figures without saying whether they are minimums or only apply when scores are sent. College Navigator (fall 2024) also reports SAT/ACT as not required but considered. International applicants whose first language is not English may submit ACT, SAT, TOEFL or IELTS as English proof.

requirements.notes: No application fee on the current freshman checklist (College Navigator listed $35 for 2024-25). FAITH REQUIREMENT: ORU is a Christian (charismatic, 'Spirit-empowered') university; the catalog says candidates are considered who show academic ability and 'Christian commitment through signing the Honor Code' at the point of application, and ORU may refuse or revoke admission. The Honor Code pledge covers conduct (e.g. no alcohol, tobacco, drugs or sex outside marriage) and chapel attendance. No pastor or spiritual reference was found on the undergraduate international pages (a minister's recommendation appears for graduate business only). International applicants also send a passport photo page, the Financial Guarantee Form with guarantor bank proof covering total cost minus scholarship, and (non-US schools) an international credential evaluation. ORU promises a 3-day decision once the steps are done; a $299 enrollment fee reserves a place.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if English is not your country's official language. Accepted: Duolingo, TOEFL, IELTS or GaoKao English 115 (GaoKao is not in this tracker's test list); ACT or SAT also accepted as English proof per the freshman checklist. No conditional admission or ESL pathway program was found on the international undergraduate pages.

english.notes: Computer-based 173, paper-based 500. TOEFL institution code 6552. No new 1-6 scale minimum is published.

aid.notes: No international need-based aid was found. ORU lists Quest Whole Leader scholarships (up to full tuition; Quest event essay and interview), an International Quest Whole Person Scholarship for international undergraduates who receive Quest (amount not published), a 'Scholarship for New Nations' for students from countries ORU has never enrolled (no amount), and a renewable $9,250 ApplyBoard award for ApplyBoard-referred students. ORU emails scholarship decisions with the admission decision. ORU reports 100% of full-time residential undergraduates receive scholarship or grant aid.

cost.notes: International undergraduate direct costs 2026-27: tuition $36,250, housing $4,910, food $6,650, general fee $1,320, technology fee $500, academic fee $360, international student fee $400 = $50,390 per year (double room, meal plan). Required fees $2,580 include the $400 international fee. Books (flat textbook fee $365 per semester per the new-student checklist) and travel are not in the total. Private university: one tuition rate for all students. The F-1 financial guarantee must cover the total minus any scholarship; add $6,000 for a spouse and $4,000 per child.
